title: Hacker Behind Musk & Obama Bitcoin Scam Faces Staggering $5M Bill as Stolen Crypto Soars
summary: UK prosecutors have obtained a civil recovery order for over £4m in crypto from the Twitter hacker, whose 2020 Twitter breach has exploited internal tools to promote a Bitcoin scam, while rising digital-asset prices and new data on 2025 hacks have sharpened scrutiny of crypto crime worldwide. title: The U.N. Security Council approves a U.S. plan for a Gaza stabilization force
summary: The plan authorizes a security force in the devastated territory and envisions a possible path to an independent Palestinian state. Russia, which had circulated a rival resolution, abstained along with China on the 13-0 vote.
